result: Added the canonical Phase 3 memory-bounded training membership-index builder on top of repaired main. The builder consumes normalized records incrementally into a local SQLite audit artifact bound to source SHA256 plus fingerprint/prototype protocol identities; it supports exact lookup and near-duplicate candidate prefiltering without loading multi-million-record training corpora into memory. Official sAlex metadata provenance is frozen to facebookresearch/fairchem commit 3801dac0cc0458a2f8121259a2ce8b23d4dcc5a1, while archive byte identity remains explicitly unresolved. Production indices and exposure-audit execution remain unauthorized.
